cw_landlord.text: Welcome to the Fleece. There's an old Cotswold rhyme about a wool pub for every mile. I don't know if that's true, but they all seem to have been called the Fleece or the Woolpack.
Have a half of the local and a ploughman's. Cheese, pickle, bread. Double Gloucester, naturally.

cw_quizmaster.text: Quiz night at the Fleece! Five questions, no phones, and no arguing about the Rollright count. We've had a stand-off.
Rules: no phones, no shouting out and no arguing with the Quizmaster. He is always right, even when he is wrong.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Suit yourself. The crisps are cheese and onion either way.
